# Three.js 0.185.1

MIT-licensed renderer and GLTFLoader, bundled from the installed dependency of the owned Form checkout. License retained. Refresh explicitly with scripts/vendor-three.mjs; no remote CDN or automatic dependency download.

Hole's bounded preview admits binary glTF 2 with geometry/material colors and no textures, external URLs or required extensions. It is a static mesh preview, not a Form/Ghost editor or full scene/animation renderer. Original bytes remain unchanged.
